functionalRequirement: For any systematic action, such as disputes aging process, a case activity will be generated, and the user who initiated the dispute case must be notified upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate and track case activities for 100% of systematic actions related to dispute processing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive logging of all dispute-related systematic actions

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The notification system must have 99.9% uptime to ensure users receive dispute case updates reliably.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for maintaining consistent communication about dispute case status

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The notification mechanism must clearly display the dispute case details, including case ID, status, and action taken, in a user-friendly format.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides clear and actionable information to the user upon login

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Notification content must be encrypted and only accessible to the authorized user who initiated the dispute case.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive dispute-related information from unauthorized access

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Notifications must be generated and queued for display within 5 seconds of case activity creation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures timely communication of case updates to the user

functionalRequirement: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately interpret 100% of initialization data for heating and cooling unit definitions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures precise derivation of unit specifications from initialization data

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Initialization data reading and unit definition derivation must complete within 2 seconds for standard configuration sets.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides efficient processing of initialization data for quick system startup

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle incomplete or partially corrupted initialization data by providing clear error messages and fallback to default configurations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures system stability when encountering imperfect initialization data

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The initialization data parsing mechanism must be designed as a separate, configurable module that can be easily updated or replaced.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for flexible modifications to data interpretation logic

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The system must support multiple standard initialization data formats (XML, JSON, CSV) for heating and cooling unit definitions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables integration with various data sources and configuration systems
